name: modelibr
description: A modern 3D model file upload service built with .NET 9.0 and React

scripts.lint: cd src/frontend && npm run lint && cd ../asset-processor && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: cd src/frontend && npm run lint:fix && cd ../asset-processor && npm run lint:fix
scripts.format: cd src/frontend && npm run format && cd ../asset-processor && npm run format
scripts.format:check: cd src/frontend && npm run format:check && cd ../asset-processor && npm run format:check
scripts.videos:generate: (cd tests/e2e && npm run test:teardown >/dev/null 2>&1); (cd tests/e2e && npm run test:setup) && (cd docs/videos && ([ -d node_modules ] || npm ci) && npx playwright install chromium && npm run generate); ec=$?; (cd tests/e2e && npm run test:teardown); exit $ec

author: Modelibr Team
